title: Chapter supplemented by other law.
bodyText:
(a) Unless displaced by a provision of this chapter, the principles of law and equity supplement this chapter.

(b) This chapter does not limit any right of a person to waive, release, disclaim, or renounce an interest in or power over property under a law other than this chapter.
bodyHtml:
[§526-4]  Chapter supplemented by other law.  (a)  Unless displaced by a provision of this chapter, the principles of law and equity supplement this chapter.

     (b)  This chapter does not limit any right of a person to waive, release, disclaim, or renounce an interest in or power over property under a law other than this chapter. [L 2000, c 43, pt of §1]
